caption:
Site stuck on "Briefly unavailable for scheduled maintenance"? 🔧

1️⃣ Open your host's File Manager (or FTP)
2️⃣ In the site's main folder, find the hidden file named .maintenance
3️⃣ Delete it, then reload the site

📌 Save this for the next update scare.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.text: Site stuck on "briefly unavailable for maintenance"?
scenes.say: Site stuck on "briefly unavailable for maintenance"? The fix takes one minute.

scenes.myth: Your site is broken for good.
scenes.fact: An interrupted update left a small file behind.
scenes.say: Don't panic. An interrupted update just left a small file behind.

scenes.title: Delete one file
items: Go to your site's main folder
scenes.say: Open your host's file manager or FTP. Go to your site's main folder. Find the file named dot maintenance. Delete it.

scenes.title: Can't see it? Show hidden files
scenes.body: Files starting with a dot are hidden by default.
scenes.say: Can't see it? Turn on show hidden files. Names starting with a dot are hidden by default.

scenes.label: your site is back
scenes.say: Reload your site. It should be back. Then run the update again.
